thread:
maria_pm: Quick async check — Q3 OKR milestone status for interop areas (runtime v2 rollout, console model dashboards, cost-opt recommendations). Post: shipped / slipped / next step + owner ping. Please keep it short.

chris_eng: runtime v2 canary shipped to us-west-2 yesterday, PR #7890 merged. Telemetry looks good: p50 down ~12% on gen workloads.

ada_prod: noted, thanks @chris_eng. Console model metrics dashboard walk-through got delayed — depends on the new metrics API from infra. Currently slipped. Owner: @ada_prod -> coordinating with @zack_infra.

zack_infra: infra change (metrics API v2) is scheduled for 2026-03-19 02:00-03:00 UTC (low traffic). There is a DB migration step. Recommend no full-traffic rollouts during that window.

chris_eng: heads up — the canary revealed a mem growth pattern at long seq lengths (repro in staging). Short-term fix: reduce batch size for high-seq routes. Filed issue #412. Will push a mitigation branch.

oliver_research: eval harness flagged small BLEU/QA regen vs baseline on a few prompts after v2. Not critical but visible in the long-tail. I'll post example cases in the eval doc. Owner: @oliver_research to triage with @chris_eng.

lena_sre: FYI oncall saw two cpu spikes this morning tied to model-mirror-syncs. Might be related to the mem growth. I'm adding runbook note and temporary autoscale bump.

ada_prod: console dashboard rollback timeline if infra slips? We can ship a limited view (model-level averages) without the full API by EOD Fri if infra delays beyond one week.

chris_eng: mitigation branch pushed: reduce batch_size from 16->8 for seq>2048 routes. Deploy tag: v2-mitigate-20260317. Need a quick CR review on #7902.

maria_pm: action items summary: 1) @chris_eng follow up on mem growth + CR for #7902 (owner) 2) @zack_infra confirm migration window and any rollback plan (owner) 3) @oliver_research post eval examples + run flag (owner) 4) @ada_prod prepare limited console view if infra slips (owner) 5) @lena_sre confirm autoscale bump and runbook link. Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept the owner ask.

chris_eng: :thumbsup: I accept, will ping once CR merged and deploy tested.

zack_infra: :thumbsup: migration window confirmed, will add a pre-migration checklist and DB snapshot steps.

oliver_research: :eyes: I'll upload eval cases in the doc and mark severity.

lena_sre: :thumbsup: autoscale bump in place, runbook updated: https://redwood-internal/docs/runbooks/mem-spike.md

deploy-bot: deploy status: v2-mitigate-20260317 -> staging succeeded, canary queued for us-west-2 at 1766554800.

ada_prod: thanks team. I'll update the OKR doc with shipped/slipped note and owners. One more ask: if anyone expects more than 1 week delay, post here so we can escalate to Eng leadership.

maria_pm: closing note — please keep updates in-thread; I'll compile for the weekly cross-pillar digest. Last quick check: any blocked dependencies besides the infra migration?
